description: Blocks editing a tracked SOURCE file from the shell, enforcing the hyperide rule 'edits only via Edit/Write; no sed/perl/awk for editing files'. Blocks an in-place stream editor on a tracked source file (`sed -i` incl. clustered `-Ei`/`-ri`, `perl -i`/`-pi`, `gawk -i inplace`), a `>`/`>>`/`>|`/`>& file` redirect onto a tracked source file (operator may be glued: `app.ts>app.ts`), and `tee`/`dd of=` writing a tracked source file. Decided from a PARSED command (shlex-tokenized, comments stripped, `-i`/redirect read off the argv; `bash -c '...'` re-parsed incl. nesting + outer redirect) — never a raw substring, so `echo "sed -i"`, a `# sed -i` comment, and `commit -m 'use sed -i'` pass. Allows read-only sed/awk/grep filters, `gawk -i json` (non-inplace include), `>&2` fd-dups, and writes to /tmp or new/non-source files. NOT subagent-exempt. Deny-by-default: no self-service bypass (ALLOW_SHELL_FILE_EDIT env / `# shell-file-edit-ok:` sentinel removed); a would-be BLOCK consults RIG_HATCH_REQUEST_NO_SHELL_FILE_EDIT with a written justification, which asks Telegram via trusted tg-ctl and allows ONLY on an approval tap (a blank/bare 1 denies). timeout_ms 960000 covers tg-ctl ask's 900s cap plus margin so a hung ask can't race the dispatcher's timeout kill into a silent on_error=open ALLOW; a CC settings entry launching cc_hook_bridge must set timeout >960s. on_error=open (inner git lookup timeout-bounded, fails toward allow).
